name: operand-test-0e6612016b/operands_with_defaultable_values-v.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Supports [`required-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#required-params), [`defaultable-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#defaultable-params), [`included-record-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#included-record-param) and [`rest-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#rest-param) in the signature
### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The assertions require command-line operand conversion and binding to main parameters, including nullable int, a type alias, Signed16, and explicit zero/empty values overriding defaults. The subset supports these parameter signatures and ordinary function calls, but does not cover command-line main invocation or operand conversion/binding behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line operand parsing and binding to main, including explicit zero and empty-string operands overriding defaultable parameter values
test_design_notes: All seven operands are supplied; this tests preservation of supplied zero/empty values, not omission of defaultable arguments.
